guide.content:
### WELCOME TO TAKEDOWN

Takedown is a FiveM server focused on **high-speed chases** and competitive game modes. Every member has a place in a world driven by speed, strategy, and adrenaline.

Our community is built around immersion, team play, and a unique atmosphere with events, tournaments, and mutual support.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
### GET STARTED
> <#1520743657425211392> — Join the connection channel to get the direct link and server address.
> <#{rules}> — Read the rules **before** taking part.

### STAY INFORMED
> <#{announcements}> — Official announcements.
> <#1519999182663061525> — Updates and patch notes.
> <#1527375640817307758> — Server status and live information.

### NEED HELP?
> <#{support}> — Open a ticket for any question or report.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Have a good ride on Takedown.
